note: This is a single-page marketing site (no client-side router / react-router). App.tsx renders one continuous page composed of anchored sections; the navbar scrolls between them via in-page #anchors. The 'screens' below are therefore the navigable anchored sections plus two overlay/state screens (loading overlay and error fallback), each of which behaves as a distinct view to the visitor.

screens.name: Hero / Landing
screens.note: The #top hero view: cinematic looping video background, headline, scroll-driven fade/scale. First thing the visitor sees after the loading overlay.

screens.name: About / Innovation DNA
screens.note: #about anchored section presenting the three company pillars.

screens.name: Services
screens.note: #services scroll-scrubbed 86-frame canvas animation with Enterprise / Agentic AI text slides; also signals asset readiness to dismiss the loading overlay.

screens.name: Methodology
screens.note: #methodology tall sticky section with staged points over a parallax particle/nebula canvas.

screens.name: Products
screens.note: #products data-driven product showcase (ProductStage) rendering typed product blocks in an alternating split layout.

screens.name: Market Reach
screens.note: #market section contrasting the two target market segments.

screens.name: Contact
screens.note: #contact lead-capture form (Web3Forms submit + WhatsApp deep-link) with success/error states.

screens.name: Footer
screens.note: Site footer with brand blurb, links, and a (currently non-functional) newsletter field.

screens.name: Loading Overlay
screens.note: Full-screen branded loading screen shown until assets are ready AND a minimum 2.5s has elapsed; not URL-addressable, an overlay state.

screens.name: Error Fallback
screens.note: Branded 'System Interruption' screen rendered by the top-level ErrorBoundary when a render error is thrown, with a 'Restart Protocols' reload button.
